title: 第806章 大家的打算第805章 选择
slug: 重生之为蚁第816章未知岛屿
content_zh:
“秦尊者到！”
兄弟商会总部，孙云刚刚回来，秦落衣尊者就赶来了。
一时间，在座的人纷纷起身，迎接已经恢复如初的秦落衣尊者。孙云和杰里，当时在关键时刻，救下了秦落衣尊者，重伤了黑角王领主。
以秦落衣九阶尊者的实力，只要脱离了黑角王的视线，根本没有哪个亡灵能追上她。杰里还没有回来，孙云自然成为了秦落衣的感谢对象，所以直接登门拜访。
“拜见，秦落衣尊者！”
众人见秦落衣进来了，赶紧一起行礼。
虽然，秦落衣的年龄并不算太大，但实力毕竟在那里，大家可没人敢托大。八阶强者，属于各大城市的高端战力，一般人都不敢招惹。
但是，九阶尊者级别的，绝对是各王国的底牌，绝对的顶级战力。虽然，秦落衣刚刚突破到九阶尊者不久，但与八阶强者相比，完全不是一个级别的人了。
“大家不用客气，我这次是来感谢孙云弟弟的！”
秦落衣尊者也没有什么架子，向大家客气了一句，在冷锋身旁找了一个座位。显然，她对于孙云让出的主位，没有打算坐上去。
“秦尊者客气了，我们也是任务本分，是大家的配合好！”孙云赶紧亲自倒酒，客气的说道。
显然，孙云把功劳推给了大家，并不敢托大。这次，能活着回来的，确实没有多少人，五大学院的内门强者，都损失惨重。
有了孙云这个变数，昆泰学院从最弱队伍，直接成为了最强的队伍。冷锋和孙云安全回来，熊达废掉了一条胳膊，只折损了李显。
“嗯，我秦落衣谢谢大家了，已经向五大学院送去了一点心意，希望大家不要嫌弃。对于孙云弟弟，我这正好有点薄礼适合你，就当我私人送你的！”秦落衣向大家客气了一句，送给了孙云一个玉盒。
孙云成长的太快了，秦落衣也忍不住过来拉拢，答谢救命之恩正是一个合理的借口。孙云的兄弟商会，现在已经完全稳定了下来，并且成为了世硕城第一大民间势力。
此时，能上桌的人员，最低都是八阶强者，而且近半都是孙云的手下。有了这些八阶强者，谁要是想打兄弟商会的主意，不得不三思而后行了。
“那小弟就恭敬不如从命了，还望秦落衣尊者多多栽培！”孙云也没有继续推脱，直接收了秦落衣给的玉盒。
能被秦落衣亲自送过来的，自然不会是什么凡品，孙云不要就是傻子了。毕竟，有些东西是可遇而不可求的，秦落衣尊者自然会送出适合孙云的宝物。
“孙弟弟客气了，不知孙弟弟有什么打算？”秦落衣点点头，直接绕到了正题。
秦落衣这次亲自过来，自然不单单只是感谢孙云，也是想与孙云合作。孙云的眼光太毒辣，这次直接发了一波战争财，并且垄断了世硕城的一些市场。

秦落衣可是出身大家族，家族中可有不少人员要养，家族自然也会涉及一些商业。只是，这方面人才不多，所以并没有多大起色，这孙云的兄弟商会，无非是最佳的合作伙伴。
“没有多大的事，打算去一趟雪云城，就直接回学院了！”孙云没有隐瞒，直接说出了自己的计划。
雪云城，正是韩冰家族所在的城市，也算一座古城了。当然，韩家在雪云城，只能算得上一个二流家族，并没有多大的影响力。
content_en:
"Sir Qin is here!"
At the Brothers Chamber of Commerce headquarters, just as Sun Yun returned, Venerable Qin Luoyi arrived.
For a moment, everyone present stood up one after another to greet Venerable Qin Luoyi who had recovered as before. Sun Yun and Jerry saved Lord Qin Luoyi at the critical moment and seriously injured Lord Black Horn King.
With the strength of Qin Luoyi, a ninth-level venerable, no undead soul could catch up with her as long as she was out of sight of the Black-Horned King. Jerry hadn't come back yet, so Sun Yun naturally became the object of Qin Luoyi's gratitude, so he went directly to visit him.
"Greetings, Venerable Qin Luoyi!"
When everyone saw Qin Luoyi coming in, they quickly saluted together.
Although Qin Luoyi is not too old, his strength is there after all, and no one dares to overestimate him. Eighth-level powerhouses belong to the high-end combat power of major cities, and most people do not dare to provoke them.
However, those at the ninth-order venerable level are definitely the trump card of each kingdom and have the absolute top combat power. Although Qin Luoyi had just broken through to a ninth-level master, he was not at the same level as an eighth-level master.
"You're welcome, I'm here to thank brother Sun Yun this time!"
Venerable Qin Luoyi didn't have any airs. He greeted everyone politely and found a seat next to Leng Feng. Obviously, she had no intention of taking the throne vacated by Sun Yun.
"Your Majesty Qin, you're welcome. It's our duty and it's thanks to everyone's cooperation!" Sun Yun quickly poured the wine himself and said politely.
Obviously, Sun Yun gave the credit to everyone and did not dare to give it too much credit. This time, not many people were able to come back alive. The inner sect experts from the five major colleges all suffered heavy losses.
With Sun Yun as a variable, Quintiles Academy went from being the weakest team to becoming the strongest team. Leng Feng and Sun Yun returned safely. Xiong Da lost one arm and only lost Li Xian.
"Well, I, Qin Luoyi, would like to thank you all. I have sent some thoughts to the five major colleges. I hope you won't dislike it. For brother Sun Yun, this is just a small gift suitable for you. Just treat it as a personal gift to you!" Qin Luoyi said politely to everyone and gave Sun Yun a jade box.
Sun Yun grew up too fast, and Qin Luoyi couldn't help but come to win over him. It was a reasonable excuse to thank him for saving his life. Sun Yun's Brothers Chamber of Commerce has now completely stabilized and has become the largest private force in Shishuo City.
At this time, the people who can serve on the table are at least eighth-level experts, and nearly half of them are Sun Yun's subordinates. With these eighth-level powerhouses, anyone who wants to take advantage of the Brothers Chamber of Commerce must think twice before doing so.
"Then it's better to obey my orders than to be respectful. I hope Venerable Qin Luoyi will cultivate you more!" Sun Yun did not continue to shirk and directly accepted the jade box given by Qin Luoyi.
Anyone who could be sent here by Qin Luoyi in person would naturally not be an ordinary person. Sun Yun would be a fool. After all, some things can be encountered but cannot be sought, so Venerable Qin Luoyi will naturally give away treasures suitable for Sun Yun.
"Brother Sun is so polite. I wonder what brother Sun has planned?" Qin Luoyi nodded and got to the point.
Qin Luoyi came here in person this time, not only to thank Sun Yun, but also to cooperate with Sun Yun. Sun Yun's vision was too vicious. This time he directly made a wave of war fortune and monopolized some markets in Shishuo City.
Qin Luoyi comes from a big family. There are many people in the family to support, and the family is naturally involved in some business. However, there are not many talents in this area, so there has not been much improvement. Sun Yun's Brothers Chamber of Commerce is nothing more than the best partner.
"It's nothing big. I plan to go to Xueyun City and then go back to the academy!" Sun Yun did not hide anything and directly told his plan.
Xueyun City is the city where the Han Bing family is located, and it can be considered an ancient city. Of course, the Han family can only be regarded as a second-rate family in Xueyun City and does not have much influence.
